subject: End-of-quarter debrief and prioritization: action items for OKR scoring
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: End-of-quarter debrief and prioritization: action items for OKR scoring

Team —

Thanks for the early Q1 work getting evidence into the central folder. With the QBR on the calendar for the 3rd, we need a light, tight scoring and narrative process so leadership has clear rationale and we can publish the rollforward. Two quick asks to get us over the line: 

1) Scoring: please add your numeric scores (0.0 - 1.0) and a 1–2 sentence rationale per KR in the attached Q1-evidence-pack.xlsx. Use the scoring-guidelines.pdf as the rubric (linked).

2) Narrative: capture the 200–300 word narrative for each objective you own in the shared doc. Call out one example of customer impact, one lesson learned, and the single priority for the next quarter.

3) Evidence & sign-off: link any external artifacts (PRs, dashboards, customer emails) into the Drive folder so audit folks can validate after we publish.

Timeline: please complete scores and narratives by Thursday EOD (Feb 25). I'll consolidate and send the leadership synthesis on Friday (Feb 26) for a quick read before the QBR packet is finalized.

Attachments: Q1-evidence-pack.xlsx (sheet per objective), scoring-guidelines.pdf

If you expect major disputes on any score, flag it inline and we can escalate to a 10–15 minute sync with Vivek & me.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
---
Note: External partners AvaTech and Acme Cloud are included in the evidence folder for customer-impact examples (no need to copy them on internal scoring threads).

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter debrief and prioritization: action items for OKR scoring

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear asks. Two quick process notes:

- I propose we split "evidence collection" and "judgement scoring" into two passes. Pass 1 (by Wed EOD) = evidence linkbacks and any objective-level disputes noted as comments in the sheet. Pass 2 (by Thurs EOD) = final numeric scores and narratives. This keeps reviewers from guessing when evidence is still flowing.

- Can we hold a 20-minute pain-point triage on Thursday 9am PT (invite I just sent) for any contested scores >0.3 delta across reviewers? Saves back-and-forth email.

I'll coordinate with Finance for any discount/credit discussions that might affect the commercial OKR evidence (Acme Cloud procurement thread referenced).

Vivek
Chief Operating Officer, Redwood Inference

Quick update from Growth side — added scores and short rationale for the three objectives I own (see laura_okr_notes.docx attached). High-level picks below so you don't need to open everything right away: 

- Obj: "Self-serve activation" — score 0.75. Rationale: steady conversion lift from onboarding funnel; one major bug in onboarding flow cost ~0.05. Evidence: funnel experiment IDs 184/189 in Drive.
- Obj: "PLG growth by expansion" — score 0.55. Rationale: healthy ARR expansion but time-to-first-dollar longer than forecast; Acme Cloud pilot narrowed but not yet repeatable.
- Obj: "Sales enablement & playbooks" — score 0.80. Rationale: new playbooks published; measurable reduction in demo-to-trial time.

I'm flagging Acme Cloud procurement as a potential area for a qualitative addendum — they surfaced a contract nuance that affects our "commercialization" KR. Vivek, please loop Finance.

Subject: Re: End-of-quarter debrief and prioritization: action items for OKR scoring

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Short synthesis and next steps (I'll attach the consolidated packet to the QBR folder in Drive):

- Completed: Most scores + narratives are in the sheet; engineering evidence folder looks complete; Laura's addendum on Acme Cloud noted.
- Open: Two contested KRs (Growth: commercialization KR and Platform: latency-target KR) — flagged in the sheet. We agreed in the triage to resolve by Friday EOD with an explicit owner for the tie-break.
- Owners & deliverables: Laura will finalize the Growth addendum (due Fri EOD). Tessa to confirm latency measurement methodology (due Fri EOD). Marissa to assemble customer-impact one-pagers for the QBR packet. I will produce the leadership synthesis and a one-page decision log.

Final deadline reminder: please have everything in (scores + narratives + evidence links) by Fri 26 Feb 2027 5:00pm PT. I will publish the consolidated packet and a short reading guide for execs.

Attachments: final-evidence.zip (contains consolidated exported artifacts; see Drive link for originals)

If anything changes, flag inline and we'll escalate in the Friday tie-break window. Appreciate the speed here.

Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
